MessageToJson: convert a protobuf message to a JSON formatted string with optional pretty printing and field name control
MessageToDict: convert a protobuf message to a Python dictionary conforming to the proto3 JSON specification
Parse: parse a JSON string representation into a protobuf message object with optional unknown field handling
ParseDict: parse a Python dictionary representation into a protobuf message object with optional unknown field handling
_Printer: create a JSON format printer class for protocol messages with configurable serialization options
